events.title: Demo Coming Soon
events.summary: Hey everybody! Thank you to those who participated in the playtest we really appreciate everyone who came through on that for us! That being said the demo will be releasing early next month! We are going to show off 10 levels and 3 boss's with some more new features we've implemented! NOTE: Everything is still subject to change as we work on the project, we have many more plans to implement more items, inventory systems, events, and more. AS OF NOW the game is up to 27 levels and multiple boss's

events.title: Demo Coming Soon
events.summary: Hey everyone! We are happy to announce that in June we will be releasing a FREE demo to the public!While our playtest is running players who've got access are encouraged to join the discord to report any bugs we may have missed https://discord.gg/M5mr9wpr . The demo will consist of a large portion of the full game stopping after a certain level, players will have access to everything we've been working on. However note that all things are subject to change and adjustments as we continue to work
